about.title: Every store. One door.
about.lead: Nexaro brings the best Palestinian fashion stores for men, women and youth into one place and delivers to your door.
about.p1: Every Palestinian city has its own standout stores: Hebron's leather, Nablus's weaving, Ramallah's tailoring. But reaching them isn't always easy.
about.p2: Travelling between cities means hours on the road and checkpoints that can close at any moment. So we decided to make the journey for you: you choose from home, and we go to the store and come back to you.
about.p3: We're based in Ramallah and work with stores in Nablus, Hebron, Bethlehem, Jenin and Jericho, with new stores joining all the time.
about.value1Text: We support Palestinian stores and put their pieces in front of new customers in every city.
about.value2Text: Shop from any city without leaving home or waiting at a checkpoint.
about.value3Text: We choose stores and pieces with care, so you find quality without a long search.
about.baseText: From Ramallah we coordinate with the stores, arrange delivery to every city, and follow every order until it reaches you.

how.title: From the store to your door
how.intro: From browsing to your doorstep in four simple steps.
how.step1Text: Explore pieces from six stores in six cities. Search, or choose men, women or youth, then filter by style, city and size.
how.step2Text: Pick your size and colour. Our size guide helps you get it right.
how.step3Text: Tap the order button and a ready message with the details reaches us. We confirm the price and delivery with you.
how.step4Text: We collect the piece from the store and bring it to you. No travel, no checkpoints.
how.faq1A: We're finalising price lists with each store. Until then, we send you the exact price on WhatsApp before you confirm your order.
how.faq2A: We deliver to all cities, through the store itself or a partner delivery company. We confirm the delivery fee and timing with you on WhatsApp before you order.
how.faq3A: Cash on delivery. Online payment is coming later.
how.faq4Q: What if the size doesn't fit?
how.faq4A: You can exchange a piece within 3 days of receiving it, if it's unworn with its tags still on. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll arrange it with the store.
how.faq5Q: Are the pieces original, from the stores themselves?
how.faq5A: Yes. Every piece comes directly from the store shown on its page.

sizeGuide.title: Find your size
sizeGuide.intro: Measurements are approximate and fit most men's and youth pieces; they can vary slightly between stores and for women's pieces. If you're not sure, ask us on WhatsApp before you order.
sizeGuide.chestText: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, just under the arms, keeping the tape level.
sizeGuide.waistText: Measure around your waist where you usually wear your trousers.
sizeGuide.inseamText: Measure from the top of your inner thigh to just below the ankle.
sizeGuide.footText: Stand on a sheet of paper, mark your heel and longest toe, then measure between them.
sizeGuide.tip: Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed fit, down for a slim fit.
sizeGuide.askText: Send us your height, weight and the piece you want, and we'll help you choose.
sizeGuide.whatsappMessage: Hello Nexaro, I need help choosing my size.

policies.title: Exchange, payment & delivery
policies.intro: Everything you need to know before you order, clearly.

sections.title: Exchange policy
body: You can exchange a piece within 3 days of receiving it, as long as:
list: it's in the original condition you received it in.
after: To request an exchange, message us on WhatsApp at {whatsapp} with the piece and the size you'd like. We arrange the exchange with the store, depending on the size and colour available.
Any delivery fee for the exchange is confirmed with you on WhatsApp before it goes ahead.

sections.title: Payment
body: For now, payment is cash on delivery: you pay in cash when your order arrives.
We confirm the final price and the delivery fee with you on WhatsApp before your order is confirmed, so there are no surprises at the door.
Online payment is coming later, and we'll announce it when it's available.

sections.title: Delivery
body: We deliver orders to all cities, through the store itself or a partner delivery company.
The delivery fee and timing depend on your city, and we confirm both with you on WhatsApp before your order is confirmed.
If your order is late or something goes wrong, message us at {whatsapp} and we'll follow it up with you.

terms.title: Nexaro terms of use
terms.intro: By using the Nexaro website or ordering through it, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: About Nexaro
body: Nexaro is a platform from Ramallah that shows products from Palestinian clothing stores in one place and coordinates orders between customers and stores. The pieces are sold by the stores themselves.

sections.title: Orders
body: Orders are sent through WhatsApp. An order is only confirmed once we've confirmed the price, size, colour and delivery fee with you.
We may have to decline an order if a piece is no longer available; we'll tell you straight away.

sections.title: Prices and payment
body: Prices aren't shown on the website yet; we send them to you when you order. Payment is cash on delivery, as described in our payment policy.

sections.title: Delivery and exchanges
body: Delivery and exchanges follow the policies on our exchange, payment and delivery page.

sections.title: Product information
body: We work to keep information accurate, but colours may differ slightly from the images. Some images are currently illustrations until the stores' own photos are added.
Each store is responsible for the quality of its pieces and for matching their description; we follow up with the store on any issue you raise.

sections.title: Using the website
body: Please use the website for lawful purposes only, and don't copy its content or images without permission.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time, and we'll publish the new version on this page with its update date.

sections.title: Contact us
body: For any question about these terms: WhatsApp {whatsapp} or email {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We collect as little data as possible and use it only to get your order to you.

sections.title: What we collect
body: We only collect what we need:
list: When you order on WhatsApp: your name, phone number, delivery address and order details.
When a store applies to join: the store name, owner's name, city, phone number, Instagram link and message.
On your device only: the site language you chose, saved in your browser.

sections.title: How we use it
body: To confirm and deliver your order and contact you about it, and to get in touch with stores that apply to join.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: We share with the store and the delivery company only what's needed to deliver your order, such as your name, phone and address. We never sell your data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep data only as long as we need it to serve your order, or as required by law.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to see, correct or delete the data we hold about you, on WhatsApp {whatsapp} or by email {email}.

sections.title: Analytics
body: The website doesn't currently use tracking or advertising tools, though it loads its fonts from Google Fonts. If we add analytics later, we'll update this policy first.

sections.title: Contact us
body: For any question about your privacy: WhatsApp {whatsapp} or email {email}.
